title: DeepEn2023: Energy Datasets for Edge Artificial Intelligence
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a benchmark dataset called DeepEn2023 to measure the energy consumption and carbon emissions of deep neural network models running on edge devices.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the energy consumption and environmental sustainability of AI on edge devices.
